fdroid:io.github.mouse233.localsendkotli.name: LocalSend Kotlin
fdroid:io.github.mouse233.localsendkotli.summary: An unofficial, lightweight Kotlin LocalSend client for older Android devices.
fdroid:io.github.mouse233.localsendkotli.description:
LocalSend Kotlin is an unofficial, lightweight native Android LocalSend client written in Kotlin. This project is not affiliated with or endorsed by the official LocalSend project. It aims to interoperate with the official LocalSend clients and provide secure file transfer on local networks, including older Android devices.
Implemented features:
- LAN device discovery using LocalSend v2 UDP multicast, with an HTTPS scanning fallback and selectable network interfaces.
- Read-only LocalSend v2 device information endpoint (/api/localsend/v2/info), including the device fingerprint.
- Sending and receiving files, folders, media, text, and clipboard content.
- Multi-file queues with progress, cancellation, configurable receive behavior, and history.
- HTTPS, certificate-fingerprint identity verification, optional PIN authentication, and SHA-256 checksums.
- System Default, Simplified Chinese, and English interfaces, with English as the fallback for unsupported system languages, plus theme colors, dark mode, device and favorite management, and network and transfer settings.
- Foreground-service transfers with lock-screen support, notifications, and an optional keep-screen-awake mode.
- Android Quick Settings tile for toggling the background transfer service on Android 7.0 (API 24) and later.
- Android system share target for single files, multiple files, and text content.
Compatibility:
- Android 5.0 (API 21) and later.
- Both devices must be connected to the same local network.
- The client advertises protocol version 2.0 and implements the main LocalSend v2 discovery and upload workflows; complete protocol conformance has not been verified. The browser download API is not implemented (download: false).
- Guest networks, AP/client isolation, multicast filtering, or vendor firewalls may prevent discovery or the TCP connection.
Storage:
- Android 10 and later uses MediaStore to save files to the public Downloads directory by default.
- Android 5.0 through Android 9 uses the Download/LocalSend Kotlin directory by default and requires legacy storage permission.
Current limitations include a less polished transfer queue interface, no browser-link receiving, no multi-threaded transfers, no large-file performance optimizations, and no resumable transfers. Android 4.x is not supported.
This is an Alpha project suitable for early-user testing. When reporting an issue, include the Android version, device model, both client versions, and reproducible steps.

fedora-packages:api-sanity-checker/api-s.summary: An automatic generator of basic unit tests for a shared C/C++ library
fedora-packages:api-sanity-checker/api-s.description: API Sanity Checker (ASC) is an automatic generator of basic unit tests for shared C/C++ libraries. It is able to generate reasonable (in most, but unfortunately not all, cases) input data for parameters and compose simple ("sanity" or "shallow"-quality) test cases for every function in the API through the analysis of declarations in header files. The quality of generated tests allows to check absence of critical errors in simple use cases. The tool is able to build and execute generated tests and detect crashes (segfaults), aborts, all kinds of emitted signals, non-zero program return code and program hanging. It may be considered as a tool for out-of-the-box low-cost sanity checking (fuzzing) of the library API or as a test development framework for initial generation of templates for advanced tests. Also it supports universal format of tests, random test generation mode, specialized data types and other useful features.

fedora-packages:flexmark-java/flexmark-j.description: Flexmark-java is a Java CommonMark (spec 0.28) parser using the blocks first, inlines after Markdown parsing architecture. Its strengths are speed, flexibility, Markdown source element based AST with details of the source position down to individual characters of lexemes that make up the element and extensibility. The API allows granular control of the parsing process and is optimized for parsing with a large number of installed extensions. The parser and extensions come with plenty of options for parser behavior and HTML rendering variations. The end goal is to have the parser and renderer be able to mimic other parsers with great degree of accuracy. This is now partially complete with the implementation of Markdown Processor Emulation. This package contains an extension for converting text prefixed with `|` to aside tags. The syntax is the same as block quotes with the marker changed to `|`.

fedora-packages:gearmand/gearmand.name: gearmand

fedora-packages:ghc-io-streams/ghc-io-st.description: The io-streams library contains simple and easy-to-use primitives for I/O using streams. Most users will want to import the top-level convenience module "System.IO.Streams", which re-exports most of the library: For first-time users, 'io-streams' comes with an included tutorial, which can be found in the "System.IO.Streams.Tutorial" module. firefox-addons:3108480.name: Theme Studio for Codeforces
firefox-addons:3108480.summary: Prototype. Themes for Codeforces problem pages and tables. Not affiliated with Codeforces.
firefox-addons:3108480.description:
Dark mode and handcrafted themes for the whole of Codeforces: problem statements, standings, status, contests, profiles, blogs and the problemset. Theme Studio is a Codeforces theme extension that modernises the site without moving anything: one clean typeface, sticky table headers, verdict pills, and rating colours that keep their meaning.
Switch looks in all open tabs, no reload needed. Off brings back exactly the stock page.
Made for competitive programmers who practise daily, sit rated rounds, and want a dark theme or simply a nicer place to read a statement.
FOUR THEMES
• Midnight: calm and dark, no picture.
• Anime Studio: 18 anime scenes, a different arc for each difficulty, or your own picture.
• Pixel Art: an 8-bit arcade world.
• Vintage Paper: a newspaper of cream sheets on a walnut desk, a warm light look.
RATING COLOURS YOU CAN STILL READ
Newbie grey to Legendary red keep their hue in all four. Each shade is checked for contrast on the real page, so a red handle is as readable as body text.
A GUIDED LAYOUT (OR KEEP CODEFORCES' OWN)
• Division badges say who a round is for: Div. 4 Beginner, Div. 3 Easy, Div. 2 Intermediate, Div. 1 Advanced.
• Problem ratings carry a word: Easy, Medium, Hard, with quick filters.
• The next round as a card with a big countdown and one Register button.
• Solved and tried problems marked on the problemset when you're signed in.
• Prefer the original arrangement? Compact keeps all positions and only changes the look. During a running contest the page is always Compact.
EVERY SUBMISSION IS A FIGHT
• Anime Studio: a VS screen for unsolved problems, a combo counter while the judge runs test N, a finisher on Accepted, time stop on TLE, and a screen shatter on a failed system test.
• Pixel Art: ROUND 1 FIGHT!, K.O.! on Accepted, PERFECT! on a first try, CONTINUE? on a wrong answer.
• Vintage Paper: EXTRA! EXTRA! a front page for an Accepted, a CORRECTION slip for a wrong answer.
• Level up: when a contest raises your rank, a moment in the new rank colour and a card to share.
• Each moment is short, skippable with any key, silent if you like, and a still frame with reduced motion. Nothing plays in a live contest unless you turn it on.
ANIME STUDIO: ANY PICTURE AS YOUR BACKGROUND
• Scenes from train windows to moonlit shrines and dragons, one per difficulty, or add an image of yours.
• The glass over the art is solved for each picture, so tables and statements stay readable.
• Japanese text in the moments can be switched to English.
FAST AND PRIVATE
• Scrolling large standings was measured against the stock site.
• No account, no analytics, no servers. Settings and pictures stay in the browser.
• Two requests, both only when you are signed in and only about you: your rating history from the official API (at most every 6 hours, for the level-up moment), and, when a verdict gets stuck on "Running", your latest submissions until the verdict is in.
• Works in English and Russian, on Gym pages too.
Found a bug or want something new? Use Report bug in the popup.
Some scene artwork designed by Freepik – Magnific.com .
Theme Studio is an independent project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Codeforces.

apple-macos:6782811117.name: Davvy: WebDAV Video Player
apple-macos:6782811117.description:
Davvy is a free WebDAV video player for your own movies and TV shows. Browse your server as a library with posters, episode details and Continue Watching on iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple TV.
Requires access to a WebDAV server and your own video files. Davvy does not include films, TV subscriptions or server hosting.
A LIBRARY THAT LOOKS THE PART
• Posters, backdrops, ratings and synopses fetched automatically
• TV shows organised into seasons with episode names, stills and runtimes
• Recently Added, Continue Watching, and a Play button that always knows the next episode
• Messy filenames, box sets and loose files cleaned up into proper titles
PLAY MP4, MOV, MKV AND MORE
• Native playback for MP4 and MOV with Picture in Picture and AirPlay
• A built-in engine for MKV, AVI and more — no conversion, no transcoding server
• Subtitle and audio-track selection, plus manual audio sync for wireless speakers
• Resume positions sync between your devices through iCloud
ONE LIBRARY, THREE ROUTES
• Add a home address, a Tailscale address and a public address for the same server — Davvy picks the fastest one it can reach
• Limit scans to the folders you choose and exclude the ones you don't
PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no tracking, no analytics
• Your server credentials and watch history live in your private iCloud, never on our servers
Davvy requires a WebDAV server (Synology, QNAP, TrueNAS, Nextcloud, rclone serve, Apache or nginx DAV, and more) and does not provide any content of its own.
Artwork and metadata by TMDb. This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB.

Sync Google Health (formerly Fitbit) to Apple Health with Syncfit
Syncfit makes it easy to transfer your health and fitness data from your Google Health (formerly Fitbit) account to Apple Health.
You can sync the following data:
Active Energy
Blood Oxygen
Body Fat Percentage
Body Mass Index
Cardio Fitness Score
Cycling Distance
Cycling Speed
Dietary Energy
Flights Climbed
Heart Rate

Respiratory Rate
Resting Energy
Resting Heart Rate
Running Speed
Sleep
Steps
Swimming Distance
Walking + Running Distance
Walking Speed
Water
Weight
Workouts
Getting started is simple. Download Syncfit, connect your Google Health account, grant the required permissions, connect Apple Health, and tap Sync. You can sync your latest data or import your historical health records into Apple Health.
## Frequently Asked Questions
Q: What does Syncfit do?
A: Syncfit transfers your health and fitness data from Google Health to Apple Health, making it easy to keep your Apple Health records up to date.
Q: Why should I sync Google Health with Apple Health?
A: Apple Health becomes a single place to view your health data alongside information from your other health and fitness apps.
Q: Is Syncfit easy to use?
A: Yes. Simply connect your Google Health account, authorize Apple Health, and tap Sync.
Q: Can I import my historical data?
A: Yes. Syncfit can transfer both recent and historical health data from your Google Health account.
Q: Is my data secure?
A: Yes. Syncfit transfers your data securely and does not sell your personal health information.
Q: Can I choose what to sync?
A: Yes. You decide which health categories to transfer, including steps, sleep, workouts, heart rate, weight, and more.
Q: Will Syncfit overwrite my existing Apple Health data?
A: No. Syncfit adds compatible records to Apple Health without deleting your existing data.
Q: How accurate is the transferred data?
A: Syncfit transfers the data provided by Google Health without modification.
Q: Is Syncfit free?
A: Steps are available for free. A subscription unlocks all supported health and fitness data types.

Hot Player is a video player for iPhone and iPad. Add your own playlist and play it with a fast, easy-to-use interface.
Hot Player is a media player only: it does not provide, host or include any content, channels or playlists.
How it works:
- Add a playlist from a provider you already use: an M3U / M3U8 link, or an Xtream Codes account (server URL, username and password).
- Tap "Upload your playlist" in the app: the page opens inside the app and links your playlist to this device.
- Every feature is available to every user, in every country.
Key Features:
- M3U / M3U8 playlists and Xtream Codes accounts
- Hardware decoding up to 4K, HDR10 and HLG
- Live streams with EPG (TV guide) and automatic reconnection
- Audio and subtitle track selection, external subtitles
- Resume playback where you left off
- Search by voice in your playlist
- Favorites, PIN lock, hidden groups, sorting and search
- Local copy of your playlist, available when the provider is unreachable
- Available in 13 languages
Free trial and Hot Player Premium: Hot Player is free to try on each device. After the trial, Hot Player Premium keeps the player active on the device; it does not include any content. Buy it at any time with the purchase icon in the menu or on the playlist home screen.
Hot Player Premium: 1-year auto-renewable subscription, charged to your Apple ID. It renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it in your Apple ID account settings.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://hotplayer.app/privacy

ScriptWidget - Create Widgets with JavaScript
ScriptWidget makes it easy to build beautiful, custom widgets for iOS and macOS — all with JavaScript and a simple, intuitive JSX-style syntax.
Start with a template, then write, preview, and refine your widgets in minutes.
# Key Features:
- JSX-Style Scripting: Quickly create widgets with familiar JSX-like syntax, making layouts easy and clear.
- Instant Preview: See your changes live as you code.
- Multi-Platform Support: Build for both iOS and macOS with a single script.
- Lightweight and Flexible: No need for heavy frameworks or external libraries.
- Safe and Secure: Widgets run locally. Network and AI requests are used only for features you configure or permit.
# Who is ScriptWidget for?
- Developers who want to customize their home screen.
- Creators who love coding lightweight tools.
- Anyone looking for a fast and fun way to build personal widgets.
Get started today and bring your ideas to life — one script at a time.
